caption: A flashlight pointed at a wall is swung up to the ceiling, and the lit spot leaves the wall and appears on the ceiling.

sa.check: A flashlight is pointed at a wall.
It is swung up to the ceiling.
The lit spot leaves the wall and appears on the ceiling.
The swing comes first and the spot moves with it.

pc.expect: The spot travels up the wall and onto the ceiling continuously with the beam, and the wall goes dark once the beam has left.
pc.fail: The spot jumps; or the wall stays lit; or the spot stays on the wall while the beam is on the ceiling.

pc.expect: The spot moves only as the flashlight swings.
pc.fail: It drifts with the flashlight still; or moves before the swing; or flickers.

pc.expect: The spot is one patch that stretches as the beam grazes the corner.
pc.fail: It splits; or is a sharp square; or keeps a fixed shape across the corner.

pc.expect: The spot moves the same way the beam swings.
pc.fail: It moves the opposite way; or crosswise; or jumps.
A second spot appears; or the flashlight vanishes; or the spot becomes solid.

pc.expect: The wall and the ceiling stay the same.
pc.fail: The wall changes colour; or the ceiling changes; or the flashlight changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged. Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
